integrity: The proof exhausts the four factorization types available when Omega is at most two: primes, prime squares, and squarefree semiprimes on each side of a consecutive pair. The only surviving algebraic cases are 4,5 and 14,15. The packaged checker is corroborative and does not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only consecutive Dedekind-psi collisions for which both integers have at most two prime factors counted with multiplicity. It does not address higher multiplicative-complexity collisions. The exact collision database contains many such higher-layer examples. An equivalent low-complexity observation may exist in unindexed computational notes.
title: Consecutive Dedekind-psi collisions at multiplicative complexity two
